recovery_review.status: Approved final product and shared fixture source; no blocking findings. Final ten-method before/after, 54-method adjacent and 32-method integration receipts audited.
recovery_review.actual_flow: offer_safe_session_recovery -> accepted Yes -> real recovery-load worker -> load_cached_image -> recovery_loaded queue event -> _apply_recovery_snapshot.
recovery_review.root_cause_and_fix: load_snapshot.has_image describes current file availability. A checkpoint that requires an image must not turn into a settings-only restore when its image is missing, invalid or unreadable. The new strict raw image_required flag is distinct from availability, and the worker rejects a missing required result before publishing recovery_loaded.
reviewed_invariants: Stop is checked before the new missing-required-image error, preserving cancellation priority.
A failed or missing required image publishes no recovery_loaded event, so the existing source, profile/options, saved area and resume state cannot be adopted from that failed checkpoint.
The invalid-modern-reference case does not call the loader with a missing digest, preventing fallback to an unrelated legacy image.
Explicit settings-only checkpoints remain accepted and do not load an unrelated legacy image.
The checkpoint bytes remain available after a failed read, and repair followed by retry restores the correct image/settings with input disarmed.
The old has_image boolean retains availability semantics for diagnostics and existing consumers. The new field is derived on load, not a persisted schema or options change.
Both offered/current snapshot comparisons and clear_snapshot_if_current consume the same derived dictionary; the added flag does not bypass the existing stale-check or atomic compare/clear guard.
recovery_review.fixture_lifetime: After worker joins, the shared batch37 fixture releases ScreenTaskWindow.root and app.screen_task_window on the creator thread. Both askyesno patch sites now retain their existing call assertions and clear Mock call/return/side-effect history in finally. This releases parent=root aliases even on failures. No product GC, test skip, wait relaxation or suppressed assertion was added.
recovery_review.fixture_provenance: Both accepted final baseline and after runs use the same final shared fixture d30737b9ef4e34f9d5867309d591c06f15dcd16a9aeac95c30d3baf87f8b8e37 and unchanged final ten-method test file. Final adjacent54 and integrated32 use that fixture too.
recovery_review.test_scope: Ten real storage/decode/hash/worker/queue/Tcl cases cover hash mismatch, matching-digest undecodable data, deletion after acceptance, byte limit, pre-existing missing modern/legacy images, invalid modern reference with orphan legacy data, Stop priority, successful repair/retry and settings-only restoration.
recovery_review.limits: This review concerns the actual offered recovery worker path; it does not claim new validation of arbitrary direct calls to private _apply_recovery_snapshot with fabricated state.

cpu_palette_review.status: No blocking findings in the final source/test pair.
invariants: For normal CPU input larger than 4096 pixels, unchanged RGBA compositing happens one scoring tile at a time and the previous tile is released before the next composite.
Candidate order, strict cost comparisons/ties, alpha arithmetic, skip-white, custom-color policy and 32-color scoring tiles remain unchanged.
The small CPU path and reuse of an already prepared CUDA host composite remain compatible; successful OpenCL still avoids unused host preparation.
OpenCL failure reaches the bounded CPU path only after native cleanup; cancellation and retained host exceptions release partial buffers.
Clearing closure cells in finally is an ownership completion with zero additional behavior IDs.
cpu_palette_review.memory_claim_limit: Only necessary float32 host RGB composite scratch becomes tile-bounded. Raw/source RGB, visibility, indices and public PixelMap storage remain proportional to image size. No constant-total-memory, RSS or physical-GPU claim.
